plugins.name: slashy
plugins.description: Operate Gmail and Google Calendar through Slashy with guided inbox, follow-up, meeting, relationship, and automation workflows.

skills.name: inbox-automation-builder
skills.description: Design and manage Slashy email, calendar, reminder, Slack, or iMessage automations. Use when the user wants a recurring rule, alert, reminder, or trigger rather than a one-time action.
skills.description_zh: 设计及管理 Slashy 邮件、日历、提醒、Slack 或 iMessage 自动化，适用于循环规则、告警、提醒和触发器，而非一次操作。

skills.name: inbox-briefing
skills.description: Build a concise Slashy briefing from the user's important Gmail threads and Google Calendar. Use for morning briefings, daily planning, inbox overviews, and priority summaries.
skills.description_zh: 从用户重要 Gmail 会话及 Google Calendar 汇总简明 Slashy 简报，适用于晨间简报、每日计划、收件箱概览和优先事项摘要。

skills.name: meeting-to-email
skills.description: Prepare for a meeting or turn meeting context into scheduling and follow-up email through Slashy. Use for meeting briefs, availability, invitations, agendas, and post-meeting follow-up.
skills.description_zh: 通过 Slashy 准备会议或将会议背景转为排期与后续邮件，涵盖会议简报、空闲时间、邀请、议程和会后跟进。

skills.name: relationship-brief
skills.description: Assemble a Slashy relationship brief from email, meetings, saved memories, and optional public research. Use before a reply, meeting, introduction, or account review.
skills.description_zh: 根据邮件、会议、已保存记忆及可选公开研究，形成 Slashy 关系简报。适用于回复、会议、引荐或客户复核前准备。

skills.name: reply-follow-up-sweep
skills.description: Separate Gmail conversations waiting on the user from conversations awaiting someone else, then prepare grounded drafts. Use for reply sweeps, follow-up sweeps, unanswered mail, and closing open loops.
skills.description_zh: 区分 Gmail 中等待用户回复与等待他人回复的会话，再依据事实准备草稿。适用于未回复邮件清理、跟进及关闭未完成事项。

skills.name: welcome-to-slashy
skills.description: Orient a newly connected Slashy user and verify their Gmail, Google Calendar, and timezone without modifying data. Use for onboarding, capability questions, or first-run setup.
skills.description_zh: 只读引导新接入 Slashy 的用户，验证 Gmail、Google Calendar 和时区，不修改数据。适用于初次使用、能力了解或接入设置。
